# ALSflow

> ALSflow is a one-person Czech studio in Prague with three lines of work, sold and priced
> separately: **websites**, **small custom software**, and **AI assistants**. Fixed price for an
> agreed scope, stated up front, with a reply to any enquiry within 48 hours on working days.
> Operated by Retail Shops s.r.o. (IČO 02512556, VAT CZ02512556), Dolnoměcholupská 522/12a,
> 102 00 Praha 10, Czech Republic. Contact: info@alsflow.cz

## The three lines of work

### 1. Websites — https://alsflow.cz/tvorba-webu
Hand-written HTML, CSS and JavaScript. No CMS, no plugins, nothing that has to be updated every
month and can break when it is. Includes design, copywriting, deployment, domain and DNS setup,
and ongoing maintenance. Hosted on Vercel with Cloudflare DNS. Text and contrast are checked
against WCAG 2.2 AA before launch. Live in 6 to 10 working days from the initial call; the client
gets a link to the work in progress along the way. Small edits during maintenance are done within
2 working days.

Measurement is the client's decision, not a fixed policy: a presentation site can run with no
tracking at all, in which case no consent banner is needed; an e-shop or booking system normally
wants analytics, which is set up together with a correctly configured consent banner.

Built so far: gen1.cz (political movement GEN, 11 pages, news editor behind Cloudflare Access),
znalecsekelova.sk (Slovak court expert in construction, 8 pages, Slovak), alsflow.cz.

### 2. Custom software — https://alsflow.cz/vyvoj-softwaru
Small tools one developer can deploy in weeks, not months: admin panels over data the client
already has, integrations between systems that do not talk to each other, automation replacing
manual spreadsheet work, and reporting. Built alongside existing systems through an API or an
export rather than by migrating them. A short analysis produces the scope and a fixed price for
that scope; the deadline is agreed per project size. Source code, accounts and documentation
belong to the client. Data runs in the EU under an Art. 28 GDPR processing agreement.

Delivered so far: the catalogue admin panel and availability integration for WE LOVE EVENTS,
a Prague AV and event rental company.

### 3. AI assistants — https://alsflow.cz/ai-asistenti
An assistant that answers customers, takes bookings and sends reminders, in Czech and in the
client's own tone, running on the channels the client already uses (e-mail, WhatsApp, their
website). When it is not sure, it hands over to a human rather than inventing an answer.
Setup takes 5 to 7 working days. Monthly billing, no long-term contract, cancel anytime.

- **E-mailové odpovědi** — https://alsflow.cz/e-mailove-odpovedi — the assistant reads and answers
  customer e-mail. Includes 1,500 e-mails and a monthly activity report. 2,500 CZK/month.
- **Rezervace a připomínky** — https://alsflow.cz/rezervace-pripominky — booking around the clock,
  confirmations, and a reminder the day before. Includes 750 bookings. 4,500 CZK/month.
- **Zpětná vazba a opakované rezervace** — a message after the visit, feedback, and a well-timed
  offer to book again. Unlimited messages. 2,500 CZK/month.
- **All three together** — 7,500 CZK/month.
- **Custom** — multi-channel assistants and system integrations, priced per project.

One-time setup for an assistant: 8,000–10,000 CZK.

Industry pages: https://alsflow.cz/ai-asistent-pro-fyzioterapeuty ·
https://alsflow.cz/ai-asistent-pro-kadernictvi

## Who buys what

- **Websites** — sole traders, small firms and organisations that need a presentation site that
  will still work in two years and that somebody else keeps running. Includes clients outside
  Prague and in Slovakia.
- **Custom software** — small firms losing hours to retyping between systems or to a shared
  spreadsheet nobody trusts.
- **AI assistants** — appointment-based local businesses, mostly in Prague: physiotherapists,
  hair and beauty salons, veterinary clinics, dentists, wellness studios. The owner works with
  their hands, cannot get to the phone, and loses bookings to missed calls and slow replies.

## How ALSflow works

- **Fixed price for an agreed scope.** No open hourly billing. If the client asks for something
  extra mid-project, the price of that change is given before the work starts.
- **A reply within 48 hours on working days**, with a proposed time for a call.
- **One person.** The client deals with Jakub Ryvola directly, not an account manager.
- **Everything in the client's name** — domain, accounts, source code, documentation. Leaving
  does not break anything.

## Does not do

E-shops, mobile apps for the App Store or Google Play, systems for hundreds of thousands of
users, and taking over undocumented legacy projects. This is said at the first call, not after
a month.
